##### Project general facts

Equestra is an elegant chapter in refined community living within the Grand Polo Club & Resort, a destination where nature, wellness, and equestrian heritage converge. Designed to balance luxury and tranquility, the development features contemporary architecture rooted in Arabian elegance. Its landscape flows naturally around polo fields, stables, and scenic green corridors, creating a serene sanctuary that celebrates the art of living well.

The project offers a collection of 3- and 4-bedroom townhouse-plexes and 5-bedroom luxury residences, each crafted with precision and grace. Interiors reflect timeless craftsmanship with equestrian-inspired details, blending refined textures, neutral palettes, and open layouts. Every home is positioned to overlook linear parks or polo greens, allowing residents to enjoy a sense of openness, peace, and connection.

Equestra redefines leisure and outdoor living through a curated range of premium amenities. Residents can enjoy The Clubhouse, The Stables, and The Polo Fields, alongside a linear park, riding arenas, and wellness zones. Additional facilities include fitness areas, picnic spaces, basketball and multi-use courts, and community centers — all designed to foster movement, mindfulness, and belonging.

##### Location description and benefits

Explore the refined elegance of the Grand Polo Club and Resort by Emaar, a sophisticated sanctuary located within Dubai Investment Park 2. This development is not just a residential area but a lifestyle destination that harmoniously combines luxury with sustainability. Surrounded by expansive green spaces and pristine polo fields, the resort is a haven for equestrian enthusiasts and lovers of tranquil living.

Its strategic location offers seamless access to key points across Dubai, ensuring both convenience and connectivity. The architectural design and community planning reflect a commitment to comfort and aesthetic excellence, integrating modern amenities within a serene environment. Residents enjoy a blend of upscale living and natural beauty, where every detail is curated to support a holistic lifestyle — from leisurely rides on dedicated trails to moments of relaxation in beautifully landscaped parks.

Crafted with eco-conscious principles, the community incorporates energy-efficient solutions and sustainable materials, highlighting Emaar’s dedication to environmental responsibility. Whether choosing a luxurious villa or a stylish townhouse, homeowners at the Grand Polo Club and Resort experience a unique fusion of elegance, functionality, and forward-thinking design.
